author: Safaa Syria
title: Two Pictures from the Summit of Mount Hermon Sum-up Two Eras
text:
In the same place and spot, two stands, separated by 52 years. We raised the flag of Syria on the summit of Mount Hermon, and it was raised by the men of Hafez al-Assad, the Ba’ath Party, and the Syrian society, because those who participated in liberating the summit were a mix of all Syrians: Muslims and Christians, Sunnis, Alawites, Druze, and Kurds…
Today, on the same summit, in the time of those sent by the Day of Judgment and the time of ‘lift your head’ (the chant of al Qaeda terrorists achieving ‘freedom’), we looked up, and we saw the blue flag as the Israelis returned without any fighting, they took the picture on the same summit they fled in the times of Hafez al-Assad, and returned to it and entered it during the time of the ‘Omayyadis’.
A Message to the Website from a Syrian Resister
Imagine, they took the highest peaks without shedding a single drop of blood, because the Muslims and the Mujahideen were plucking the Druze mustaches in Sweida and killing the children of the Oak trees on the coast, and became like cats in front of the Israelis.
We will remain proud that the Israelis were locked in the Golan cages like rabbits, because we were on top of the mountain and fighting for our homeland. And in your time, the Syrians became like rabbits surrounded and mocked by the Israelis from the summit of Jabal al-Shaikh – Mount Hermon.
And the strange thing is that in the 1967 war, we fought and killed a lot of Israelis. But in this al-Joulani time, the Zionists took 3 provinces at once, without fighting, without a single bullet, and without shedding a single drop of blood, the cheapest victory ever, in the time of the Omayyadis who dance today.
Salute to the great Syrian Army that fought the world for fifty years and held out.
Salute to every member, and every martyr and wounded in the Syrian Arab Army, and all that they have given will remain a debt around our necks, and we will work hard to restore their strength.
The Israelis will descend from the summit of Mount Hermon, and the sons of the Day of Judgment and the sons of the Omayyads will flee with them. This is an unwavering debt.
Two pictures from the Summit of Mount Hermon encapsulate two eras; this is our red era, and this is your blue era, oh revolutionaries, this spot sums up the Syrian story.
(From Naram Sarjoon’s diary with edits)
